title.narrative: Supporting health facilities in Al-Buqa'a District, Republic of Yemen with medical and non-medical equipment

description.narrative: Addressing the significant shortage of medical equipment and furniture in hospitals and health centers in the Republic of Yemen and helping to alleviate the suffering of Yemeni patients in Al-Buqa'a District and surrounding areas.
Securing medical equipment and furniture for Al-Buqa'a District.Providing medical supplies for Mandaba and Nahouqa.
To provide assistance to the health sector through medical equipment and furniture, thus helping to alleviate the shortage in Al-Buqa'a District and surrounding areas in the Republic of Yemen.
